objective: A working integrated paper opportunity system, not another isolated winner table. Profitability, frequency, drawdown and rejection reasons must all be measured. No guarantee of stable profit or500%.
integration: finruntime MarketSnapshot/StrategySnapshot -> existing risk/planner -> existing PaperBroker/PaperAccountState; durable operation via existing run_paper_cycle. Do not create an exchange submission adapter or modify the production stack defaults.
instrument: BTCUSDT spot, fully funded long/cash; one shared position. Four shadow strategy accounts are calibration observations only and are NEVER summed as portfolio equity.

definitions.daily_trend: Daily EMA10>EMA50 and daily close>EMA50. Stop max(5%,2*dailyATR14/close); hypothetical target3x stop; signal exit on lost daily trend, maximum30 days.
definitions.trend_pullback: Daily trend positive, hourly close below EMA20 and RSI2<15. Stop max(1%,2*hourATR14/close), target2x stop; maximum24 hours.
definitions.range_rebound: Hourly20 efficiency ratio<0.25, close below mean20 minus2 standard deviations, RSI2<10; target preceding20 mean, stop max(1%,2*hourATR14/close); maximum12 hours. No short position.
definitions.breakout: Closed4h close above previous55-bar high, daily trend positive. Stop max(2%,2*4hATR14/close), target3x stop, maximum96 hours. Only fresh closed4h breakout pulses, not repeated reuse of one candle.

scan: One decision per completed hourly signal frame; live quote-only risk checks may run more often. Default one full hour signal delay. Never call scan frequency filled-trade frequency.
qualification: Before each decision, only already CLOSED shadow trades strictly before decision time enter the trailing365-day evidence window, at most60 trades/family. Require>=12 trades spanning>=2 UTC months, PF>=1.10, mean net return minus1.28 standard errors>0, and positive mean if the same trade commissions were doubled. This is a heuristic filter, not statistical proof or multiplicity correction. No synthetic backfilled qualifications.
ranking: Eligible raw opportunity with highest historical conservative mean net return; ties by family name. Only one position; no averaging, no parallel use of the same capital. Current positions exit under their own rules, not merely because another family appears.

costs.move_gate: gross target room >=3x round-trip declared costs; not a profit prediction

execution: Protective stops on next available quote; historical replay uses actual hourly OPEN only and cannot promise intrahour stops. No retrospective low/high stop fills. Native paper broker is the sole fill/accounting implementation. Partial fills and retries must not duplicate entry; stale quotes/future bars block new exposure.
data: Reuse exact134 Binance archives from PR124 artifact9977552924, verify manifest and source hashes. Warmup before2024. Any gap in2024 onward fails replay; old gaps reset indicators. No futures substitutions or missing-price synthesis.

periods.calibration_observation: 2024 with four independent shadow paper accounts
periods.evaluation: 2025-01-01 to2026-09-01 exclusive,608 days, one portfolio cash balance without January reset

history_status: All historical periods already seen in previous research. This is new-system reused-history testing, NOT pristine OOS. Report all predeclared outcomes and cash control. No retuning after seeing PnL.
engineering_tests: partial execution does not duplicate quantity
unproven models never enabled for real orders
delivery: Native runtime module, bounded CLI step/watch, paper status and decision audit, tests, all backtest rows and deployment runbook through PR. Do not activate an unattended production process or change the existing scheduler without reporting it.
